planets.name: TOI-544 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-544 with a 1.55-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-544 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-544. Its orbit and size follow Osborne et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
